title: Inside Sales Executive (WFH / Remote)
description:
**About Us** 




**PascalBlue Studio is a growing digital web agency and product foundry. We help businesses transform their digital presence by building high\-converting websites and optimizing their local visibility (Google Business Profiles). We are looking for a hungry, fluent communicator to join our remote team and drive our B2B outreach.** 




  





**The Role** 




**As an Inside Sales Executive, your primary focus will be generating new business by cold calling local and national companies. You will pitch our custom website creation packages, explain the value of having a professional online presence, and close deals.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Make daily outbound cold calls to a provided list of business owners and decision\-makers.
* Pitch website development and local SEO services clearly and confidently.
* Understand customer pain points (e.g., outdated website, no local search ranking) and position our services as the solution.
* Follow up consistently with warm leads via phone and WhatsApp.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, prospect statuses, and follow\-ups in a basic CRM or Google Sheet.



  





**What You Will Earn** 



* **Base Salary:** 
 ₹10,000 fixed per month.
* **Incentive:** 
 10% commission on every closed sale. (For example, selling a ₹40,000 website package puts an extra ₹4,000 directly into your pocket).
* **Earning Potential:** 
 Uncapped. The more you clients you close, the more you make.


- 


**Requirements** 



* **Language Skills:** 
 Strict fluency in English, Hindi, and Bengali is mandatory. You must be able to switch languages seamlessly based on the client's comfort.
* **Workspace Setup:** 
 Must have your own smartphone, a stable internet connection, and a quiet, distraction\-free environment for making professional calls.
* **Experience:** 
 6\+ months of experience in telecalling, BPO, or B2B sales is preferred, but highly motivated freshers with excellent communication skills are welcome to apply.
* **Traits:** 
 High energy, resilient against rejection, and entirely target\-driven.



  





**Why Join PascalBlue Studio?** 



* **100% Remote:** 
 Work from the comfort of your home.
* **High\-Value Product:** 
 You are selling a service every business actually needs to survive today.
* **Direct Growth:** 
 Work directly with the founder and learn the mechanics of B2B tech sales.



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Send your resume and create a short 30 seconds video loom talking in hindi, bengali and english about your experience and qualifications for 30 seconds. We are judging your communication skills in all 3 languages.

title: Client Acquisition Lead – Finexa Platform
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Client Acquisition Lead – Finexa Platform
   

**Location:** 
 Remote (Work From Home)
   

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About Finexa**
 Finexa is India’s leading wealth\-tech platform offering end\-to\-end solutions for Mutual Fund
   

 Distributors (MFDs), RIAs, and financial advisory businesses. We empower financial
   

 professionals with robust tools for operations, analytics, client management, and business
   

 growth.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Client Acquisition Lead will manage the entire client acquisition lifecycle for the Finexa
   

 Platform. This includes conducting product demos, addressing lead queries, ensuring
   

 smooth onboarding, collecting subscription charges, driving renewals, and maintaining highquality CRM data. The role is fully remote and requires excellent communication and
   

 relationship\-building skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**1\. Product Demonstrations**
 • Conduct detailed and engaging online demos of the Finexa Platform for leads
   

 generated through various channels.
   

 • Customize demonstrations to highlight platform features relevant to the lead’s
   

 business objectives.
   

  

**2\. Lead Engagement \& Query Resolution**
 • Interact professionally with leads to resolve queries, address objections, and provide
   

 clarity on platform capabilities.
   

 • Ensure timely and accurate responses to help leads evaluate the platform effectively.
   

  

**3\. Subscription Conversion**
 • Convert leads into paid Finexa subscribers by collecting subscription charges.
   

 • Guide clients through the payment and subscription activation process.
   

 • Collaborate closely with the Marketing Team to stay updated on ongoing trial pack offers, festival promotions, and campaign\-driven initiatives.
   

 • Leverage these marketing programs strategically during conversations to keep leads engaged, drive interest, and enhance the overall sales conversion process.
   

  

**4\. Coordination With Telecalling Team**
 • Work closely with the Telecaller Team for scheduling and rescheduling demos.
   

 • Ensure seamless coordination to maximize demo attendance and lead engagement.
   

  

**5\. Client Onboarding Coordination**
 • Collaborate with the Customer Success Team to ensure smooth onboarding of MFDs/Advisors post\-subscription.
   

 • Track onboarding progress and ensure all necessary steps are completed.
   

  

**6\. Referral Management**
 • Collect referrals from existing paid Finexa clients and ensure they are added to the pipeline for further follow\-up.
   

  

**7\. Renewal Management**
 • Engage with clients approaching subscription expiry.
   

 • Ensure timely renewal follow\-ups and maximize retention.
   

  

**8\. CRM Management**
 • Maintain complete and accurate records of all leads, calls, demos, follow\-ups, conversions, and renewals.
   

 • Ensure strict CRM data hygiene and timely updates.
   

  

**9\. Reporting**
 • Generate periodic (daily/weekly/monthly) reports on lead status, calls done, followups completed, demos conducted, conversions, and renewals.
   

 • Share insights and recommendations to improve acquisition processes.
   

  

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
 • Excellent communication and presentation skills
   

 • Strong ability to explain SaaS solutions clearly and confidently
   

 • Effective objection\-handling and customer engagement skills
   

 • High follow\-up discipline and persuasion abilities
   

 • Ability to collaborate with Telecalling and Customer Success teams
   

 • Proficiency in CRM systems and accurate data maintenance
   

 • Target\-oriented mindset with strong focus on conversions and renewals
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
 • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
   

 • 1–4 years of experience in client acquisition, inside sales, or SaaS sales
   

 • Experience in fintech, mutual funds, or financial services preferred
   

 • Preferred: NISM VA Certification
   

  

**What We Offer**
 • Remote Work (Work From Home)
   

 • Competitive salary with attractive performance incentives
   

 • Opportunity to grow in a rapidly scaling wealth\-tech company
   

 • Exposure to a comprehensive financial technology ecosystem
   

 • Collaborative and supportive work environment

title: Gold Loan Sales And Operations Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Muthoot FinCorp ONE, a strategic business unit of Muthoot FinCorp Ltd., is building a transparent digital financial ecosystem with products across lending, saving, investing, protection, and remittances. The company offers convenient services such as Gold Loans from home while maintaining the strong values and service quality of the Muthoot Pappachan Group. As part of one of India’s most reputed financial services groups, Muthoot FinCorp ONE benefits from a legacy that spans automotive, financial services, hospitality, alternate energy, real estate, and precious metals. The focus is on creating secure, reliable, and user\-friendly digital financial solutions that enhance customer experience and accessibility.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kolkata for a Gold Loan Sales and Operations Executive. The role involves engaging with customers to explain gold loan products, assessing gold ornaments, and processing loan applications in line with internal policies and compliance requirements. The executive will manage daily branch operations related to gold loans, including documentation, data entry in internal systems, cash handling, and reconciliation of transactions. Responsibilities also include following up with customers for renewals and repayments, maintaining accurate records and reports, and supporting promotional activities to drive business growth. The role requires close coordination with branch staff and management to ensure smooth service delivery and a high level of customer satisfaction.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer service and relationship management abilities, with a focus on clear communication and a professional demeanor.
* Basic financial and operational skills, including handling cash transactions, verifying documentation, and maintaining accurate records.
* Comfort with digital tools and branch software for data entry, reporting, and tracking gold loan accounts.
* Attention to detail and adherence to compliance, security, and company policies in all gold loan operations.
* Ability to work on\-site in a branch environment in Kolkata, collaborate with team members, and meet sales and operational targets.
* Prior experience in retail banking, NBFC operations, or gold loans is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: a graduate degree in any discipline; additional certifications in finance or banking are a plus.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Position Purpose
 
 The Operations \& Strategy Lead acts as the chief liaison and operational bridge between the Promoter/Managing Director and the factory floor. Stationed permanently at the plant, this person ensures strict execution of management directives, monitors operational and financial KPIs across production and utilities, tracks customer dispatches and receivables, and coordinates business development initiatives.
 



 This is a high\-ownership operational role for a commercially sharp operator who wants to learn how to run a mid\-market industrial manufacturing enterprise.
 



  





**Location:** 
 On\-site daily at Manufacturing Facility, Hooghly, West Bengal
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Managing Director / Promoter
 



**Working Relationship:** 
 Works alongside the Plant Head, QA/QC Lead, and Commercial Accounts Team
 



**Experience Level:** 
 3–6 years post\-MBA (or equivalent operational experience)
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Promoter Cockpit \& Daily Plant Governance
 * Review and validate the Daily Production Report (DPR) generated by the plant team
* Independently flag operational anomalies, line stoppages, unapproved material consumption, or safety/maintenance lapses directly to the Managing Director.
* Track the daily utility consumption and performance metrics of the HVAC systems, chillers, and newly commissioned heat pump systems against baseline power targets.
* Ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and management directives are rigorously implemented across the shop\-floor staff.
* Prepare monthly executive MIS presentations detailing gross margins, direct cost breakdowns, debtor aging, and capacity utilisation trends for promoter review.



  




 2\. Commercial Coordination, Dispatches \& Working Capital
 * Act as the daily bridge between customer orders and plant production schedules, ensuring priority batches for key institutional accounts are produced and packaged on schedule.
* Track raw material inventory levels and reconcile daily consumption against purchasing ledgers to prevent stockouts or over\-procurement.
* Coordinate daily logistics, freight haulers, and e\-way billing for on\-time dispatches to formulation hubs in North, West, and East India.
* Assist the Managing Director in monitoring customer ledger aging, coordinating with client procurement desks to resolve dispatch disputes, and ensuring customer collection cycles remain strictly within the targeted 60–90 day window.



  




 3\. Business Development \& Sales Enablement
 * Handle inbound sales inquiries, coordinate commercial price quotations and track customer sampling for line trials.
* Actively manage the commercial follow\-up for export vendor qualifications (coordinating regulatory documentation, sample logistics, and questionnaire completion)
* Liaise with in\-country indenters, domestic sales reps, and customer procurement teams to resolve commercial, invoicing, or packaging grievances before they escalate.



  




 Candidate Profile \& Qualifications
 * **Education:** 
 Full\-time MBA (Operations, Supply Chain, or General Management) from a reputable institute. A prior Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or B.Pharm is a distinct advantage.
* **Experience:** 
 3 to 6 years of operational experience in a manufacturing plant environment, industrial B2B enterprise, supply chain role, or as an EA to a Promoter/CXO in an industrial setup.



  





**Core Competencies:** 



* **High Integrity \& Discretion:** 
 Able to maintain strict confidentiality and serve as a reliable, unbiased reporting source for the promoter.
* **Diplomatic Authority:** 
 Capable of auditing plant floor performance and asking tough questions without creating destructive friction with the experienced technical Plant Head.
* **Commercial \& Financial Acumen:** 
 Strong fluency in P\&L basics, working capital cycles, debtor aging, and spreadsheet\-based operational modeling.
* **Language Proficiency:** 
 Fluent in English and Bengali (essential for daily communication with the local shop\-floor team and local contractors); working Hindi proficiency preferred for interstate client handling.

 Middleton Chambers \& Middleton Inn is a premium event and accommodation destination located in Central Kolkata, near Maidan Metro. The property offers versatile spaces suitable for weddings, social gatherings, corporate conferences, and private events. Guests benefit from a combination of elegant event facilities and comfortable stay options in a central, well\-connected area. The team is focused on delivering professional service, personalized experiences, and seamless event execution. Middleton Chambers \& Middleton Inn continues to grow as a preferred venue for individuals and organizations seeking high\-quality event solutions in the Kolkata metropolitan area.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The Sales Executive will identify and pursue new business opportunities, including weddings, corporate events, and group bookings, while maintaining strong relationships with existing clients. Daily responsibilities include responding to inquiries, conducting venue tours, preparing proposals, negotiating rates and contracts, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth event delivery. The role involves achieving sales targets, maintaining accurate records in CRM or sales tracking systems, and participating in local networking activities to build brand presence. The Sales Executive will also collaborate with marketing to support promotional campaigns and provide feedback on market trends and customer preferences.
   

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated skills in client relationship management, lead generation, and sales negotiation.
* Experience in venue, hospitality, or event sales, with the ability to understand and present event packages clearly.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to conduct professional presentations and venue tours.
* Competence in basic office software and CRM or sales management tools for tracking inquiries, pipelines, and conversions.
* Ability to work on\-site, manage time effectively, and handle multiple inquiries and events simultaneously.
* Prior experience in the hospitality or events industry in Kolkata or similar markets is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial.
* Comfort with working flexible hours, including weekends and evenings, based on event and client requirements.

title: Financial Advisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is a government\-owned life insurance corporation, founded in 1956 and headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. As a leading player in India’s life insurance sector, LIC offers a comprehensive range of products including life and health insurance, pension plans, ULIPs, group schemes, and micro insurance. The organization serves a broad spectrum of residential and non\-residential customers through an extensive network of agents and branches across India and overseas. LIC focuses on financial protection and long\-term wealth creation, providing stable career opportunities and growth for professionals in the insurance and financial services domain.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Financial Advisor role based in Kolkata, with a hybrid work arrangement that allows some work from home. The Financial Advisor will engage with clients to understand their financial goals and risk profiles, and recommend suitable LIC insurance, investment, and retirement solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting financial needs assessments, presenting product options, preparing proposals, and supporting clients through the policy lifecycle. The role involves maintaining long\-term client relationships, following up on renewals, and staying updated on LIC product offerings and regulatory guidelines. The Financial Advisor will collaborate with branch teams and management to achieve sales and service targets while upholding ethical standards and customer\-centric practices.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Financial Planning and Retirement Planning to assess client needs and design appropriate solutions.
* Candidates should possess Finance and Investments skills to explain product features, returns, and risk profiles clearly.
* Candidates should possess Financial Advisory skills to provide objective, compliant, and client\-focused recommendations.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and long\-term client relationships.
* Basic proficiency in using digital tools and online platforms for client communication, documentation, and reporting.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet defined sales and service targets.
* Prior experience in insurance, banking, or financial services is an advantage but not mandatory.
* A minimum of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in finance, commerce, business, or related fields is preferred.

**Sales Executive** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, New Delhi, and Kolkata, India
 



**Experience:** 
 2\-4 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Ultrafresh is a leading modular kitchen and home interior brand transforming houses into stylish, functional homes. Powered by the TTK Prestige Group, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, with regional offices in Delhi, Bengaluru, and Kolkata and more than 200 studios across India. Ultrafresh serves customers through kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, combining design\-led thinking with practical home solutions. Its advanced manufacturing capabilities and focus on innovation support consistent product quality and scalable customer delivery. The business blends craftsmanship and technology to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality, while its studio network enables local engagement and consultation. As one of India’s fastest\-growing home lifestyle brands, Ultrafresh is expanding its reach by connecting customers with solutions tailored to their requirements, budgets, and living spaces. The company’s sales teams play a direct role in converting customer needs into satisfying, commercially successful home interior outcomes.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Sales Executive, you will own customer acquisition and revenue development across your assigned local market. You will generate demand through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationships with customers, architects, interior designers, builders, and relevant businesses. Through face\-to\-face consultations, you will understand requirements, present suitable modular kitchen and home interior solutions, and convert qualified opportunities into sales. You will manage the sales pipeline, maintain accurate interaction records, negotiate pricing and terms, and prioritize opportunities that improve conversion and commercial outcomes. Success means building a reliable local customer base, strengthening relationships through responsive solution selling, and consistently achieving assigned sales targets. This is an onsite, field\-oriented role requiring regular travel, customer meetings, independent execution, and ownership of the complete sales process.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Generate qualified local leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationship\-led outreach, expanding the opportunity base and improving the consistency of customer acquisition.
* Identify prospective customers, businesses, architects, interior designers, and builders whose requirements align with Ultrafresh’s modular home solutions and commercial growth priorities.
* Conduct face\-to\-face meetings, diagnose customer requirements, and present relevant kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliance solutions that improve fit, confidence, and conversion.
* Build trusted customer relationships through timely follow\-up and responsive engagement, protecting satisfaction while increasing referrals, repeat opportunities, and successful project progression.
* Own the sales pipeline by tracking opportunity stages, prioritizing high\-potential prospects, and maintaining accurate customer interaction records for disciplined follow\-through.
* Analyse customer needs and recommend effective solutions, balancing functional requirements, design expectations, pricing considerations, and commercial feasibility during the sales process.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within approved parameters, protecting customer value and business margins while moving qualified opportunities toward closure.
* Deliver assigned sales targets and objectives by managing daily field activity, conversion priorities, and pipeline coverage across the local base location.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to customer conversations, enabling clear recommendations, credible value articulation, and commercially sound closures.
* Demonstrate independence and teamwork in a field\-sales environment, taking ownership of local execution while coordinating effectively with internal colleagues and customer stakeholders.
* Communicate fluently in English and Hindi, with proficiency in at least one regional language, to build trust and conduct effective consultations across the assigned market.
* Apply structured pipeline management and accurate customer\-record discipline to prioritize opportunities, maintain visibility, and improve follow\-up quality throughout the sales cycle.
* Use customer\-need analysis and consultative selling to connect individual requirements with suitable modular products, supporting stronger conversion and customer satisfaction.
* Own a two\-wheeler and be prepared for regular field travel, customer meetings, networking, and face\-to\-face business development within the local market.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling modular kitchens, home interiors, or other modular products can shorten the learning curve and strengthen solution credibility with customers.
* Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, or local business networks can accelerate qualified lead generation and improve market access.
* A proven record of meeting sales targets in the local base location demonstrates the commercial ownership needed to succeed in this role.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring at least two years of direct, field, or B2C sales experience, with evidence that you can build a local pipeline and convert opportunities into measurable revenue.
* You communicate confidently in English and Hindi and can engage customers in at least one regional language, adapting your presentation to different needs, backgrounds, and decision\-making styles.
* You are comfortable working independently in the field while contributing to a team environment, taking responsibility for prospecting, meetings, follow\-ups, records, negotiations, and target delivery.
* You listen carefully to customer requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, helping prospects understand the value of modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances.
* You bring disciplined pipeline habits, accurate record keeping, and consistent follow\-through so every qualified opportunity receives the right attention at the right stage.
* You own a two\-wheeler and are willing to travel locally for customer meetings, networking, referrals, and relationship development.
* Familiarity with modular or concept\-based product selling, plus an existing network among architects, interior designers, or builders, will help you create momentum faster.
* Most importantly, you are commercially driven, relationship\-oriented, and motivated by achieving clear sales objectives while ensuring customers receive solutions that fit their practical and lifestyle requirements.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a fast\-growing home lifestyle brand with more than 200 studios across India, giving you access to a broad market and meaningful local sales opportunities.
* Sell a differentiated portfolio spanning modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, allowing you to solve complete home improvement needs rather than isolated product requirements.
* Work with the backing of the TTK Prestige Group while combining craftsmanship, technology, and innovation to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality.
* Build a career in consultative field sales where disciplined execution, customer relationships, and measurable commercial outcomes directly shape business growth.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A role with direct ownership of local market development, customer acquisition, pipeline quality, negotiations, and sales\-target achievement.
* Exposure to a growing home interiors business with a broad product portfolio, studio network, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and opportunities to build valuable market relationships.
* A customer\-facing environment where strong performance can be demonstrated through qualified lead generation, conversion, relationship quality, and consistent commercial delivery.

title: Sales Business Development Executive
description:
Visual Foundry is a creative advertising company building advertising and visual experiences for modern brands.
 



  





 We work across AI\-powered advertising, cinematic commercials, product films, CGI, social creatives and creative production. We also provide advertising and media\-buying services for brands looking to turn creative into measurable growth.
 



  





 We are a growing company with an international focus, including businesses and clients in Australia and other global markets.
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a Sales \& Business Development Executive to take ownership of our sales process from qualified lead to closed deal.
 



  





 This is a sales\-first role, not a traditional telecalling position.
 



  





 You will speak directly with founders, business owners, marketing teams and decision\-makers, understand what they need, identify the right Visual Foundry solution, handle objections, negotiate, follow up and close.
 



  





 A large part of the role will involve inbound leads generated through our advertising, so speed, communication, qualification and consistent follow\-up are critical.
 



  





 You will also be expected to reactivate suitable older leads and build opportunities from existing prospects.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  




* Respond quickly to new inbound leads and initiate professional calls.
* Understand the prospect's business, requirements, budget, timeline and decision\-making process.
* Qualify leads based on genuine buying intent.
* Conduct discovery calls and sales conversations with Indian and international prospects.
* Communicate confidently with founders, business owners and marketing decision\-makers.
* Recommend the right Visual Foundry service based on the client's needs.
* Present proposals and communicate commercial terms clearly.
* Handle questions, objections and pricing conversations professionally.
* Negotiate and move qualified prospects toward a decision.
* Own the sales process from first conversation through
 **closing and payment coordination** 
 .
* Maintain timely and structured follow\-ups so qualified opportunities do not go cold.
* Re\-engage relevant older and previously unconverted leads.
* Keep lead information, follow\-ups and pipeline status accurately updated.
* Work closely with the founder and creative team when a prospect requires deeper creative or strategic discussion.
* Track your pipeline, conversations, meetings, proposals and conversions against targets.



  





 What You'll Be Selling
 



  





 Visual Foundry operates across two core service areas:
 



  





 Creative Production
 



 AI\-powered advertising films, cinematic commercials, product films, CGI, social creatives and other visual advertising assets.
 



  





 Advertising \& Media Buying
 



 Campaign management and advertising services, including Meta advertising, for businesses looking to acquire customers and grow.
 



  





 You don't need to be a creative professional, but you must be willing to understand what we sell well enough to communicate its value to prospects.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



  




* **Minimum 1 year of relevant sales or business development experience.**
* Strong spoken and written English.
 **Excellent spoken English is essential.**
* Confident communication skills, especially on calls and meetings.
* Strong listening and questioning ability.
* Ability to understand a prospect's actual need rather than simply pitch a service.
* Strong objection\-handling and negotiation skills.
* Excellent follow\-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Comfortable speaking with founders, business owners and senior decision\-makers.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects and sales conversations simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with CRM systems, spreadsheets or sales\-tracking tools.
* Target\-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for moving opportunities forward.
* Willingness to learn the advertising, creative and AI\-production space.



  





 What Will Make You Successful
 



  





 You don't wait to be reminded to call a lead.
 



  





 You don't disappear after sending a proposal.
 



  





 You don't treat every lead the same.
 



  





 You understand that good sales comes from asking the right questions, understanding the business problem, communicating value, handling objections and consistently moving the conversation toward the next step.
 



  





 If you can build trust quickly, communicate clearly and close business, you'll have significant ownership in this role.
 



  





 Role Details
 



 Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
 



 Work Mode: On\-site/Remote
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 1\+ year in relevant sales/business development
 



 Compensation: Fixed salary \+ performance\-based commission
 



  





 Experience:
 


* Sales: 1 year (Required)



  





 Work Location: In person

title: Head of International Sales
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 This role owns that journey. You'll be the single accountable owner of the international GP number, the international sales team, the CRM, and — most critically — the international channel and distribution network that will carry Duratuf worldwide.
 



 You won't inherit a machine. You'll build one.
 



  





**What will you own end to end** 



* The number. Carry and grow a multi\-crore international GP number targeting \~5x growth over three years. Once the plan is jointly locked, you own execution end\-to\-end — no relitigating.
* The channel. Build (not just manage) our international partner and distribution network — a tracked funnel from Identified to Scaled, a growing active\-partner base each year, dormant markets reactivated, and top partners graduated to distributor tiers.
* Retention. Grow to 1,000 active workplaces with real discipline — every customer classified by buying frequency, a weekly at\-risk report, and a recovery playbook you own.
* New categories. Take every new safety product to market internationally with a country\-by\-country GTM plan.
* The team. Hire, lead, and retain the international sales team, scaling from 2–3 to 6–10 — on a real operating rhythm of weekly reviews and quarterly scorecards.



  





**Must Have** 



* 10–14 years in international B2B industrial sales, having carried a real export GP number (safety, PPE, electricals, industrial, or adjacent)
* A partner network you built — and can name, with outcomes attached
* 3–6 distributed direct reports managed, with documented quota and retention results
* Depth across at least two of MENA / SEA / Africa / LATAM / CIS
* A CRM\-led approach — you run forecast, pipeline, and coaching from the CRM, not on top of it
* Export ops fluency: Incoterms, LC/TT, shipping docs; comfort across INR and AED flows
* Margin literacy and integrity that holds under pressure



  





**What success look like** 



* GP delivered at or above plan, quarter after quarter
* A partner network that's growing, active, and paying on time
* ≥85% of active workplaces retained year on year
* Team quota attainment ≥90%, regrettable attrition under 10%
* Rolling forecast accuracy within ±10%
* Top\-20 key accounts growing ≥20% YoY
* 3–5 new countries a year that genuinely move the number



  





**Good to have** 



* Electrical safety, PPE, or broader industrial safety background
* Experience across a dual\-entity (India \+ UAE) export structure
* Familiarity with the Zoho One ecosystem
* A warm distributor network in MENA, Africa, or SE Asia
* Exposure to EOS / Scaling Up / OKR frameworks



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
* **You build it** 
 — the engine you create becomes the backbone of a much bigger team



  





 We hire on values, not just skill — Disciplined Execution · Us Before I · Result Oriented · Inclusive Collaboration · Always Innovating · Numbers that Matter.
 



  





 How We Hire
 



 Simple, fair, and fast — a first call, a detailed interview with the CEO, a values conversation, and reference checks. Every candidate hears back at every stage.
 



  





**Apply — let's talk.**

title: Relationship Manager (Field sales) - Kolkata
description:
**Company Description** 
 TradeIndia.com, operated by Infocom Network Private Limited, is India’s largest B2B marketplace, connecting buyers and sellers across global markets. With over 11 million registered users, the platform supports manufacturers, exporters, importers, and service providers by promoting their products and services worldwide. TradeIndia offers value\-added services that enable buyers to directly contact Indian sellers and efficiently source required products. The marketplace provides comprehensive, up\-to\-date listings of diverse products and services, including detailed descriptions from both Indian and international suppliers. This makes TradeIndia a one\-stop platform for businesses seeking reliable partners and opportunities in global trade.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager (Field Sales) – Kolkata will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers using TradeIndia’s platform. This full\-time, remote role involves identifying potential clients, presenting TradeIndia’s solutions, and driving subscription and service sales to meet revenue targets. The Relationship Manager will conduct regular virtual meetings and calls with clients, understand their business needs, and recommend suitable plans and value\-added services. Daily responsibilities include managing a sales pipeline, following up on leads, ensuring timely onboarding and account activation, and providing ongoing support to enhance customer satisfaction and retention. The role also includes coordinating with internal teams for issue resolution, sharing market feedback, and contributing to local growth strategies within the Kolkata region.
   

**Qualifications**
* Sales and relationship management skills, including B2B sales, client acquisition, and account management.
* Communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to present solutions clearly, handle objections, and close deals.
* Customer service and support capabilities, such as responding to queries, resolving issues, and ensuring high client satisfaction.
* Basic digital and marketplace understanding, including comfort with online platforms, CRM tools, and remote collaboration tools.
* Strong planning and time\-management abilities to handle field sales activities remotely and manage a structured sales pipeline.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred; prior experience in B2B marketplace or SaaS sales is an advantage.
* Fluency in English and local languages used in Kolkata; familiarity with the regional business environment is beneficial.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently in a remote setup.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Daily responsibilities include prospecting and lead generation, conducting product demos, managing the sales pipeline, and negotiating and closing deals. The Business Development Manager will build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare partners, gather feedback to inform product improvements, and collaborate with marketing and product teams to align business development activities with company goals. * Prior experience in healthcare, HealthTech, medical software, or related industries is highly beneficial.

 3 \- 6 Years

 Kolkata (Onsite)

 ‍
   

  

**Tender \& Bid Management**
* Identify and track relevant government, PSU, enterprise and private\-sector tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOI opportunities.

* Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, evaluation criteria and submission requirements.
* Conduct bid qualification and feasibility analysis based on project scope, capabilities, eligibility, timelines and commercial viability.
* Prepare tender calendars, bid trackers, submission schedules and compliance checklists.

* Develop project understanding, proposed approach, implementation methodology, deliverables, timelines and resource plans.

 ‍
   

  

**Digital Marketing \& Software Project Expertise**
**Support Proposals And Tenders Related To**
* Digital marketing and performance marketing.
* SEO, SEM, social media marketing and content marketing.
* Website design, development and maintenance.
* Web portals, CMS and e\-commerce solutions.
* Mobile application development.
* Custom software development and enterprise applications.
* AI\-powered solutions, chatbots and conversational AI.
* Cloud, DevOps, application support and digital transformation.
* Creative design, branding and multimedia solutions.
* Work with internal experts to understand technical requirements and prepare relevant, client\-focused proposals.

**Technical \& Commercial Coordination**

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Support client presentations, solution walkthroughs and tender\-related meetings.

**Proposal Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Develop and maintain proposal templates, capability decks, company profiles and solution libraries.
* Track submitted bids, win/loss outcomes, reasons for rejection and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all bid documentation follows company standards and approval requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information, pricing, business proposals and internal documents.

**‍Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Pre\-Sales, Tender Management, Bid Management, Proposal Management or IT Business Development.

* ‍Role match \& offer

title: Head of Fundraising
description:
**Head of Fundraising \& Investor Relations, East – Kolkata** 




 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP
 



  





**Vantrock is a multi\-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.** 
 Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre\-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Kolkata and the East.
 



**THE SEAT** 




**Employer:** 
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:** 
 None at launch. A senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur
 



**Experience:** 
 10 to 16 years
 



 Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Vantrock is an operator\-led real assets platform, and it is multi\-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
 **the first strategy, not the platform** 
 , across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use with distribution below and office above.
 



 Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
 **A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.** 




 Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.
 



 Founded by
 **Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO** 
 . Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1\.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free; 200\+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.** 
 That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.
 



 We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING** 




 This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:
 



 – Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing
 



 – Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, starter and strata office
 



 – Plotted and industrial plot sales
 



 – Pre\-leased and yielding assets
 



 – A land strategy
 



 – Private credit
 



 – Data centres and senior living
 



 – In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures
 



**Multiple product lines, one channel.** 
 That is why this is a franchise\-building job rather than a product\-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.
 



 The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment through CIV, co\-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de\-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co\-investment tickets into named assets.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




**Own the zone.** 
 Build the distribution and IFA network across East and North\-East India: Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.
 



**Not a cold start.** 
 The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 – The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go\-live, for both the fund and the co\-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.
 



 – Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in the East.
 



**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT** 




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.
 



**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal\-only, no return promises, ever.** 




**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Essential** 




 – 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in East and North\-East India. You can name them, and they will take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.
 



 – Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



**Advantageous**

 • Manage customized branding requirements such as embossing, debossing, foil stamping, printing, engraving, labels and packaging.

 5\. COSTING \& QUOTATIONS
 



  





 • Prepare accurate product costing.
 



 • Evaluate leather, hardware, accessories, labour, packaging and manufacturing costs.
 



 • Prepare competitive export quotations while protecting company margins.
 



 • Negotiate commercially viable pricing.
 



 • Understand FOB and relevant international trade terms.
 



 • Maintain accurate costing and quotation records.

 • Track quantities, quality and delivery timelines.
 



 • Identify potential delays and communicate proactively.

 • Identify repeat\-order and cross\-selling opportunities.
 



 • Introduce relevant new products and product categories.
 



 • Expand customer relationships and account value.
 



 • Maintain professional communication with international buyers.

 • Identify new OEM and private\-label opportunities.

 • RFQs
 



 • Quotations

You should know how to turn freshers into capable salespeople, capable salespeople into closers and closers into future team leaders. Experience in digital marketing, IT services, SaaS, web/app development or other B2B services is strongly preferred.  We want someone who has already demonstrated the ability to chase ₹1Cr\+ or equivalent aggressive revenue targets per month and deliver under pressure. If your best month is still the month you talk about in interviews, you're probably not ready. We want someone who can say:

 Cold Calling • LinkedIn Prospecting • Upwork/Freelance \& Bidding Platforms • Outbound Sales • Lead Generation • B2B Partnerships • High\-Ticket Closures

 Revenue Generated \| New Clients \| Conversion Rate \| Average Deal Value \| Pipeline Value \| Team Productivity \| Target Achievement

 We offer a competitive
 **fixed salary \+ aggressive uncapped incentives \+ overachievement bonuses \+ quarterly rewards \+ surprise cash/gift rewards \+ performance trips \+ leadership growth opportunities.** 
 Hit 100% of target → full incentive. 125% → accelerated payout. 150% → enhanced incentive \+ bonus. 200%\+ → exceptional performance payout \+ surprise reward, which will blow your mind. The structure is designed so that exceptional revenue creation directly increases your earning potential. There is no reason to cap your income if you refuse to cap your ambition.

 You aren't walking into a finished sales department to maintain it. You will build the team, create the process, establish the culture and set the pace. You will have the freedom to experiment, the authority to challenge existing methods and the responsibility to deliver the outcome.

 Founded in 1961, WEG is a global electric\-electronic equipment company, operating mainly in the capital goods sector with solutions in electric machines, automation and paints for several sectors, including infrastructure, steel, pulp and paper, oil and gas, mining, among many others.

 This area includes electric motors, drives and industrial automation equipment and services, and maintenance services. Electric motors and other related equipment find applications in practically all industrial segments, in equipment such as compressors, pumps and fans, for example.

 Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.

**Paints and Varnishes**

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue, volume, and profitability targets for the assigned territory.
* Manage key customer accounts in the Aluminium (ALU) and DRI segments while strengthening long\-term business relationships.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand the customer base and market share.
* Conduct regular customer visits to understand technical requirements, resolve issues, and provide value\-added solutions.
* Prepare techno\-commercial proposals, quotations, and negotiate pricing and commercial terms.
* Coordinate with Production, Technical Services, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service teams to ensure timely order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts, demand plans, and periodic MIS reports for management review.
* Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy customer credit management.
* Participate in technical discussions, product trials, and application development at customer sites.
* Represent the organization during customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and technical seminars.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM/ERP systems and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Support product launches, business expansion initiatives, and strategic projects as assigned.
* Ensure adherence to all safety, quality, ethical, and statutory requirements while conducting business activities.


**Profile/Competencies**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Metallurgical, Ceramic, Chemical, or related discipline).
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of experience in B2B industrial sales, preferably in refractories, thermal products, steel, aluminium, or allied process industries.
* Experience in handling customers within the Aluminium, Non\-ferrous and DRI segments is preferred.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of thermal/refractory products and their industrial applications.
* Knowledge of Aluminium, Non\-ferrous and DRI manufacturing processes.
* Techno\-commercial negotiation and contract management.
* Sales forecasting, budgeting, and territory management.
* CRM and ERP systems (preferably Oracle/SAP) and MS Office proficiency.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong customer relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.
* Commercial acumen and business development mindset.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Results\-oriented with strong execution capability.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* High level of ownership, integrity, and accountability.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned region.
